description_for_model: Autonomous technical knowledge vault in Google Open Knowledge Format (OKF) with MCP 2.0 (2026-07-28) and native MCP Events. Supports fast edge note search, raw OKF note fetching (stories, concepts, MOC index), and long-running asynchronous task submission (curation, synthesis, topic research).
